Usage: gentle-ai review start [flags]

Freeze live Git scope and derive the bounded review tier, lenses, and correction budget.

Flags:
  --base-ref <value>
      optional base revision for immutable base-to-HEAD review
  --committed-only <value>
      acknowledge that --base-ref excludes dirty tracked changes (default "false")
  --contract <value>
      optional negotiated review integration contract
  --cwd <value>
      repository path (default ".")
  --focus <value>
      dominant standard-risk focus: risk, resilience, readability, or reliability; large pure documentation always uses readability (default "reliability")
  --lineage <value>
      optional explicit review lineage identifier
  --policy <value>
      optional review policy file; the native bounded policy is used by default
  --projection <value>
      candidate projection: workspace or staged; staged base-diff records post-commit delivery provenance (default "workspace")
  --target <value>
      exact frozen target identity for negotiated START
  --trace <value>
      optional diagnostic operation metadata trace path
  --workspace-overlay <value>
      include branch commits and the live workspace over --base-ref (default "false")
